name: health-check
description: Check for stale server processes and test API endpoint reachability

documentation.overview: Prevents the #1 documented pitfall: debugging correct code against a stale server process.
keyFeatures: Detects stale Node.js processes (>4 hours old)
Auto-detects recently modified routes and tests them
Distinguishes 401 (route exists, needs auth) from 404 (route not found)
important: If endpoint returns 404 but code looks correct, check for stale processes FIRST
401 response means the route EXISTS and needs authentication — this is good
404 response means the route is NOT registered or server is stale
